purpose: Standalone throwing art preparation; does not enable throwing in Bunker or change Claude's runtime.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: EIGHT consecutive pixel-art THROW animation frames for the EXACT tiny partisan grenadier in the reference, to extend an existing 66x72 pixel game sprite. The reference is the identity and drawing-style authority: preserve the olive soft partisan cap, tiny pale face, grey tunic, olive trousers, tall black boots, dark belt/straps, and rifle slung diagonally behind his right shoulder. Preserve his very plain flat 30-color low-resolution pixel drawing with thin black outlines; do not add realistic shading, beard, helmet, large eyes, ornaments or extra gear. This is NOT an art-style upgrade.
OUTPUT: a truly TRANSPARENT 1536x1024 canvas, exactly FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows; eight cells of 384x512, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. No gutters, captions, numbering, borders, ground line, shadows, environment or detached projectiles. All eight depict ONE SAME soldier at ONE SAME scale and position. Treat each cell as a magnified 66x72 sprite: its exact sprite rectangle is cell-local x=27..356, y=90..449, 330x360 pixels (5x scale). Its boots contact the same floor at y=440 in every frame; its torso, head and boots stay in register. All body/weapon/hand pixels must fit within that rectangle. Keep both feet planted and unchanged through the throw, with only slight natural torso motion. Keep the rifle attached to the back and never turn it into a weapon held in his hand.
THROW DIRECTION is towards SCREEN LEFT, with a right-hand overarm throw; a small dark olive hand grenade is visible only while he holds it. It must read as a throwing arm, not a rifle shot or salute. FRAME 1: exact reference ready stance, throwing arm extended to screen left with the small grenade. FRAME 2: pull the grenade hand inward toward the upper chest, elbow bent. FRAME 3: raise and bend that same arm up beside the head while drawing the hand back to screen right. FRAME 4: maximum windup, grenade hand behind and slightly above head to screen right, elbow raised. FRAME 5: explosive forward swing toward upper SCREEN LEFT, arm nearly straight, OPEN EMPTY HAND at the release point; grenade has just left the hand but do not draw it in flight. FRAME 6: empty throwing hand follows through forward and down to screen left, torso leans subtly forward. FRAME 7: recover torso upright, arm bending back to ready. FRAME 8: return to the exact reference ready stance and arm position but EMPTY HAND (no grenade instantly respawning). Every frame must have visibly coherent progressive changes in the arm. Same cap, face, size, trousers, boots and rifle in every frame. Alpha background must be genuinely empty, without checkerboard painted into the image.
prompts.disposition: Reference attempt retained. Windup and transparent-background cleanup requested.

prompts.prompt: Edit image 1, the eight-frame grenadier THROW spritesheet; image 2 is the exact original small game-sprite reference. Keep the same 1536x1024 dimensions and exact 4x2 cell grid, character size, feet, uniform, rifle, cap, palette and all eight positions. TWO corrections only: (1) remove ALL soft glow/grey/light halos surrounding the characters so every background pixel is fully transparent and every sprite pixel is fully opaque; hard clean pixel edges, no shadows. (2) In frame THREE (top row third cell) and frame FOUR (top row fourth cell), make the windup unmistakable: the grenade-holding hand moves ABOVE and BEHIND the head towards SCREEN RIGHT, elbow bent and raised, preparing to THROW toward SCREEN LEFT; frame four is the furthest backswing, with the grenade at cell-local approximately (265,105), behind the cap. Keep the rifle slung on the back, not held. In frame five (bottom row first) the empty throwing hand must then swing forward toward upper SCREEN LEFT as already depicted. Frames1,2,5,6,7,8 remain unchanged except for halo removal. Maintain the source's tiny flat pixel-art identity and full body. No detached grenades, captions, numbers, borders or checkerboard pattern.
prompts.disposition: Selected for mechanical packing; low-alpha background excluded during packing.
